lines: Don't cry because it's over, smile because it happened. #<Author:0x00007f8b389e1f40>
If you see someone without a smile, give them one of yours. #<Author:0x00007f8b389e1040>
Sometimes your joy is the source of your smile, and sometimes your smile is the source of your joy. #<Author:0x00007f8b389e0500>
A warm smile is the universal language of kindness. #<Author:0x00007f8b389ffc98>
What sunshine is to flowers, smiles are to humanity. #<Author:0x00007f8b389ff518>
Do not judge me by my success, judge me by how many times I fell down and got back up again. #<Author:0x00007f8b389fe398>
Don’t let a bad day trick you into thinking you have a bad life. #<Author:0x00007f8b389fcbd8>
Hardships often prepare ordinary people for an extraordinary destiny. #<Author:0x00007f8b389fb7d8>
Sometimes, carrying on, just carrying on, is the superhuman achievement. #<Author:0x00007f8b389faf18>
Life doesn’t get easier or more forgiving, we get stronger and more resilient. #<Author:0x00007f8b389fa518>
Don't judge each day by the harvest you reap, but by the seeds that you plant. #<Author:0x00007f8b389f8998>
We cannot always build the future for our youth, but we can build our youth for the future.  #<Author:0x00007f8b389f7598>
Chance favors the prepared mind. #<Author:0x00007f8b389f6e18>
Give me six hours to chop down a tree, and I will spend the first four sharpening the axe. #<Author:0x00007f8b389f6698>
It’s better to look ahead and prepare, than to look back and regret. #<Author:0x00007f8b389f5798>
There are no problems we cannot solve together, and very few that we can solve by ourselves. #<Author:0x00007f8b389f4ed8>
We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children. #<Author:0x00007f8b389f4758>
We say 'things will turn out', but no. It's what we do that actually creates the future. #<Author:0x00007f8b389f3e98>
When one tugs at a single thing in nature, one finds it attached to the rest of the world. #<Author:0x00007f8b389f2bd8>
Let us develop respect for all living things. Let us try to replace violence and intolerance with understanding, compassion and love. #<Author:0x00007f8b389f1058>
I took a walk in the woods and came out taller than the trees. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a0fb48>
Nature is painting for us, day after day, pictures of infinite beauty. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a0f3c8>
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a0d848>
The earth has music for those who listen. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a0d0c8>
To walk into nature is to witness a thousand miracles. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a0c948>
Never bend your head. Always hold it high. Look the world straight in the eye. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a0c088>
It takes courage for people to listen to their own goodness and act on it.  #<Author:0x00007f8b38a0ab48>
You’ll never do a whole lot unless you’re brave enough to try. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a0a288>
You can choose courage, or you can choose comfort, but you cannot choose both. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a09248>
Courage is not simply one of the virtues, but the form of every virtue at its testing point. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a08ac8>
No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted. #<Author:0x00007f8b38a085c8>
You can always, always give something, even if it is only kindness! #<Author:0x00007f8b38a07f88>
Good words bring good feelings to the heart. Speak with kindness, always.  #<Author:0x00007f8b38a07a88>
